## Tool name

What would `plugins/<name>` be called?

## What it does

A short description of the tool's functionality.

## Why it belongs here

Why is this a good fit for techysavvy as a standalone plugin (rather than,
say, a separate project)?

## Rough scope

What's the minimal first version? List the main routes/views/actions you
expect it to need. (`plugins/hello-tool` is the reference shape for a new
plugin — see [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).)

## Anything else

Dependencies, open questions, or prior art you're drawing from.
